title: Hi, I'm {{name}}
aboutText:
Frontend and Mobile Engineer with 6+ years of experience building fintech, crypto and digital products across web and mobile using React, React Native, Next.js and TypeScript. Currently working as a Freelance - Contractor, I collaborate with companies on production applications, greenfield products and end-to-end feature delivery.

I use AI-assisted engineering workflows for technical research, implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation and rapid prototyping, always reviewing the final output for quality and maintainability.
bioFallback: I build web and mobile products focused on performance, scalability, and clean UX.

highlights: Contribute to mobile and web applications, from greenfield projects and end-to-end feature implementation to maintenance and improvement of production applications.
Apply AI-assisted engineering workflows and explore AI-powered capabilities to accelerate development, improve problem-solving and support product experimentation.

STABLE.IO: Wallet maintenance and features for buying, selling, converting and sending cryptocurrencies; IPP greenfield MVP built from scratch with end-to-end implementation.
RECODME: contributed to building PadelPool mobile app from scratch and worked on InvertyApp's complete rebranding and new user experience.
BANCO EXTERIOR VENEZUELA: React, Next.js and React Native consulting engagement.
Main technologies: React Native, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, TanStack Query, REST APIs, Axios, Redux, Zustand, LLM, RAG, Firebase, Next.js, Git and GitHub.
